messages:
elaine (People Ops): Quick heads-up — planning a small quarterly recognition pop-up next Wed lunchtime. Goal: 50 spot-award confetti kits + 30 thank-you note envelopes. Need volunteers for packing + a pickup window from vendor. :party_popper:

mike (People Ops): love it. what are the kit contents?

elaine (People Ops): quick list: 1 sticker, 1 mini confetti pouch, 1 thank-you card, 1 $10 coffee voucher card (prepaid) + packing slip. total target cost ~ $6/kit.

sam (Facilities): vendor can do curbside pickup between 10:30–11:30am. we have a dolly and cart ready.

olivia (Finance): need a PO or expense authorization. estimate and vendor name? send to finance@redwood.com.

elaine (People Ops): vendor: Spruce Party Co. Estimate in the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/spruce-quote (see row 'Q1-pop-up'). i'll paste final in a sec.

jordan (People Ops): i can lead packing at 12:15 in the green room. how many hands?

mike (People Ops): i'll be there. can recruit 2 interns. total 4 people should do it in ~20–25min.

sam (Facilities): note — if kits include liquid confetti packs, we need secondary containment for transit. vendor says packs are sealed. still recommend tubs.

elaine (People Ops): noted. we'll use clear tubs + 2 volunteers to load to cart. action items: 1) olivia to confirm PO, 2) sam to confirm pickup window and loading spot, 3) jordan + mike to coordinate volunteers and packing table.

olivia (Finance): can approve up to $800 on a short-form expense. please send the spreadsheet and vendor invoice to approver chain. i'll route it quickly.

mike (People Ops): sending spreadsheet now. @jordan can you copy-paste packing checklist into the sheet? i added columns: name, kit_num, notes.

jordan (People Ops): done. added a `fragile` column for confetti handling and a `voucher_checked` box.

lunch-bot: Reminder set: "Recog pop-up pickup" on 2026-04-08 10:45am (organizer: elaine).

elaine (People Ops): question about distribution: do we do an open desk drop or manager hand-off for spot awards?

mike (People Ops): for spot awards i'd prefer manager hand-off — keeps it personal and avoids people missing desks. still leave some extras at the stand for walk-bys.

sam (Facilities): suggest we reserve hallway table near kitchen for 11:45–1:15. i'll block it and post signage.

olivia (Finance): small note — coffee vouchers are being processed as prepaid gift codes, not physical cards. vendor will send CSV codes; we must include a single code card in kits that points to the recipient's email for redemption.

elaine (People Ops): good call. jordan — can you coordinate with engops to map emails for recipients on the day? we will have a printed manifest and a QR code linking to the CSV for managers to confirm.

jordan (People Ops): yep. i'll export template `recipients.csv` and leave a link in the sheet. also adding a quick script snippet managers can scan: `python send_voucher.py --csv recipients.csv --template kit-msg.html`

mike (People Ops): volunteers: @amy, @devin, and two interns confirmed. amy can take lead from 12:10.

amy (Volunteer): happy to help. i'll bring my label maker.

devin (Volunteer): i'll be there for packing and loading.

elaine (People Ops): perfect. last thing — do we need HR sign-off on message copy for the thank-you card? i'm keeping copy generic (no monetary mention). sample: "Thanks for everything you bring to the team — small token from Redwood."

olivia (Finance): HR copy ok but keep it non-promissory. finance ok with wording.

sam (Facilities): i'll bring extra scissors, tape, and a marker. also a bin for recycling confetti waste.

jordan (People Ops): packing checklist complete in sheet. final headcount for kits = 80 (50 spot + 30 extras).

elaine (People Ops): excellent. final reminders: pickup 10:45am, packing 12:15, pop-up 11:45–1:15. i'll post a follow-up thread tomorrow with final vendor invoice attached. thanks team :heart:
